meta.title: ParsRAG — Offline Persian (Farsi) RAG with cited answers
meta.description: ParsRAG is a bilingual, offline-first RAG workspace for chatting with Persian (Farsi) and English PDF, Word, PowerPoint and scanned documents using local LLMs. Every answer cites its file and page.
meta.ogDescription: Ask Persian and English documents on your own machine and see the page behind every answer. Parsing, OCR, embeddings and vector search stay local.

journey.title: What happens to a page.
journey.lead: From upload to answer, every step that touches your document runs on your machine.
journey.s1d: Add PDF, Word, PowerPoint, images, or text. The file type and size are checked before anything is read.
journey.s2d: Text layers are extracted directly. Scanned pages and images go through Tesseract OCR with Persian and English data.
journey.s3d: Text is split into passages that remember their file and page, slide, paragraph, or section. A short bridge joins consecutive PDF pages.
journey.s4d: A multilingual-e5 model turns each passage into a vector, locally, on CPU or GPU.
journey.s5d: Vectors are stored in Qdrant under the conversation they belong to. Delete the conversation and they go with it.
journey.s6d: The closest passages go to the model with your question, and the answer returns with its sources.

modes.title: You choose how much the model may add.
modes.lead: Three explicit answer modes, the same ones you pick in the composer. Here is one question, answered three ways.
modes.question: When is delivery, and why was the date moved?
modes.docText: Delivery is planned for the end of Azar 1405, after the acceptance test.
modes.strictGap: The selected documents don't say why the date was moved, so that part is left unanswered.
modes.hybridModel: The documents give no reason. Dates like this usually move when an acceptance test is added or extended; confirm with the project owner.
modes.freeModel: Documents aren't searched in this mode. Delivery dates are usually set in a project timeline or contract; switch modes to answer from yours.
modes.note: Strict mode refuses when retrieved evidence doesn't meet its threshold. It's a safeguard, not a guarantee: check important answers against their sources.

privacy.title: You decide what leaves your machine.
privacy.lead: Parsing, OCR, embeddings, and vector search always run locally. Only the model you choose decides where the answer is written.
privacy.localNote: Generation runs on this workstation. No prompt or excerpt leaves through the model adapter.
privacy.privateNote: Your prompt and the retrieved excerpts go to a server you control. Private OpenAI-compatible services can run without a key.
privacy.externalNote: Your prompt and retrieved excerpts go to a third-party service. ParsRAG asks you to acknowledge this before the first request.
privacy.always: In every mode, embeddings and Qdrant stay local, and API keys stay in memory or environment variables, never in browser storage or logs.

shelf.title: One shelf for what you read.
shelf.lead: Office files, scans, data, and code are read with their structure, so a citation can name a slide or a section, not just a file.
shelf.label: File families
shelf.b1x: Native structured extraction, with OCR for scanned or image-heavy PDF pages and images inside Word and PowerPoint files.
shelf.b2x: Validated, normalized, and read with Persian and English OCR.
shelf.b3x: UTF-8 extraction. JSON is validated and normalized before indexing.
shelf.b4x: Visible text from markup, and UTF-8 text from configuration files.
shelf.b5x: UTF-8 extraction with section metadata, so answers can point into a file.
shelf.limits: By default a conversation holds up to 10 files, each up to 100 MiB, with up to 500 MiB per upload. Office archives are checked for suspicious compression, and unsupported binary formats are rejected rather than misread.

install.title: Run it on your machine.
install.lead: You need Docker Engine with Compose and 8–16 GB of RAM, depending on the model. After the first download, a local model works offline.
install.apiComment: # Set LLM_PROVIDER=api, the model, base URL, key and disclosure flag in .env
install.then: Then open http://127.0.0.1:8000. The installation guide covers AMD, low-VRAM cards, and native development.

coda.title: Your documents stay on your desk.
coda.lead: ParsRAG is built for people who can't send their files to a cloud chatbot, and still want answers they can check.

footer.license: ParsRAG is source-available, not open source. See the license and how to cite it.
